SELECT w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, sku.sku_code AS goodsCode, COALESCE(spu.goods_name, sku.sku_name) AS goodsName, sku.spec, sku.unit, COALESCE(begin_qty.qty, 0) AS beginQty, COALESCE(begin_amt.amt, 0) AS beginAmount, COALESCE(in_qty.qty, 0) AS inQty, COALESCE(in_amt.amt, 0) AS inAmount, COALESCE(out_qty.qty, 0) AS outQty, COALESCE(out_amt.amt, 0) AS outAmount, COALESCE(end_qty.qty, 0) AS endQty, COALESCE(end_amt.amt, 0) AS endAmount FROM wms_goods_sku sku LEFT JOIN wms_goods spu ON sku.goods_id = spu.id CROSS JOIN wms_warehouse w WHERE w.del_flag = 0 AND sku.del_flag = 0
AND spu.category_id IN
#{id}
AND w.id IN
#{id}
-- 期初数量（在统计日期之前的库存） LEFT JOIN ( SELECT st.warehouse_id, st.sku_id, st.quantity AS qty FROM wms_stock st WHERE st.del_flag = 0 ) begin_qty ON w.id = begin_qty.warehouse_id AND sku.id = begin_qty.sku_id
-- 期初金额 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT st.warehouse_id, st.sku_id, st.quantity * COALESCE(sku.cost_price, 0) AS amt FROM wms_stock st INNER JOIN wms_goods_sku s ON st.sku_id = s.id WHERE st.del_flag = 0 ) begin_amt ON w.id = begin_amt.warehouse_id AND sku.id = begin_amt.sku_id
-- 入库数量 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pi.warehouse_id, pii.sku_id, SUM(pii.quantity) AS qty FROM wms_purchase_in_item pii INNER JOIN wms_purchase_in pi ON pii.purchase_in_id = pi.id WHERE pi.del_flag = 0 AND pii.del_flag = 0 AND pi.status = '1'
AND DATE(pi.create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND DATE(pi.create_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY pi.warehouse_id, pii.sku_id ) in_qty ON w.id = in_qty.warehouse_id AND sku.id = in_qty.sku_id
-- 入库金额 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pi.warehouse_id, pii.sku_id, SUM(pii.sub_total) AS amt FROM wms_purchase_in_item pii INNER JOIN wms_purchase_in pi ON pii.purchase_in_id = pi.id WHERE pi.del_flag = 0 AND pii.del_flag = 0 AND pi.status = '1'
AND DATE(pi.create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND DATE(pi.create_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY pi.warehouse_id, pii.sku_id ) in_amt ON w.id = in_amt.warehouse_id AND sku.id = in_amt.sku_id
-- 出库数量 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT so.warehouse_id, soi.sku_id, SUM(soi.quantity) AS qty FROM wms_sales_out_item soi INNER JOIN wms_sales_out so ON soi.sales_out_id = so.id WHERE so.del_flag = 0 AND soi.del_flag = 0 AND so.status = '1'
AND DATE(so.create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND DATE(so.create_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY so.warehouse_id, soi.sku_id ) out_qty ON w.id = out_qty.warehouse_id AND sku.id = out_qty.sku_id
-- 出库金额 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT so.warehouse_id, soi.sku_id, SUM(soi.sub_total) AS amt FROM wms_sales_out_item soi INNER JOIN wms_sales_out so ON soi.sales_out_id = so.id WHERE so.del_flag = 0 AND soi.del_flag = 0 AND so.status = '1'
AND DATE(so.create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND DATE(so.create_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY so.warehouse_id, soi.sku_id ) out_amt ON w.id = out_amt.warehouse_id AND sku.id = out_amt.sku_id
-- 期末数量 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT st.warehouse_id, st.sku_id, st.quantity AS qty FROM wms_stock st WHERE st.del_flag = 0 ) end_qty ON w.id = end_qty.warehouse_id AND sku.id = end_qty.sku_id
-- 期末金额 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT st.warehouse_id, st.sku_id, st.quantity * COALESCE(sku.cost_price, 0) AS amt FROM wms_stock st INNER JOIN wms_goods_sku s ON st.sku_id = s.id WHERE st.del_flag = 0 ) end_amt ON w.id = end_amt.warehouse_id AND sku.id = end_amt.sku_id
WHERE (COALESCE(in_qty.qty, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(out_qty.qty, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(end_qty.qty, 0) > 0) ORDER BY w.warehouse_name, sku.sku_code
